name: cline
label: Cline
description: Autonomous coding agent CLI by Cline Bot

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not configured — set an API key (press e) or run: cline auth

env_config.name: CLINE_API_KEY
env_config.description: API key for the selected provider (passed to Cline with -k). Leave blank to use `cline auth` (account or provider sign-in).

env_config.name: CLINE_PROVIDER
env_config.description: Cline provider id (e.g. cline, anthropic, openai, openrouter). Leave blank to use Cline's configured default.

env_config.name: CLINE_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id for the selected provider.
